items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: In those days we traveled, even Cabby traveled in two cars. We had a baggage car and a pullman... So we got on the stage and played the first set.

ctx.x: He was a big draw, Cab was.

Oh, one of the biggest. I tell you, we had nine thousand people in New Orleans the first time he was there. We had 11,000 people at the race track underneath the grandstand -- the dancefloor had 11,000 people. Yes, yes. Cab was a big sensation all over the country. I can tell you an incident that happened. We were in a town called Longview, Texas. In those days we traveled, even Cabby traveled in two cars. We had a baggage car and a pullman, that's how we traveled. And we're on the side track lying up in upper…

going to have the sheriff and six deputies there." I said, "By God, what you got here?" He said, "Well, it's tough. I came here from Georgia with my colored boys and I carried my little arrow head pistol and I protected them. Same as I'm going to protect you all tonight." So he said, "Don't worry. They're going break up -- they're going to fight. They're going to fight all over the place -- they got money." This was a white we were playing for, too. So, sure enough, we got way out to this road house, way out on…
